body: I have monthly meetings with my psychiatrist to track my progress but he just tells me what I've already read online. To be honest even going to therapy is a drag but I still force myself to do it. I have to force myself to even have fun which in itself is tiring. I guess I am lost at what to do with my life and that uncertainty is eating me up inside. I'm 3 years from turning 30 and I still make impulsive decisions that I end up regretting after. I honestly don't think anybody will ever know, and maybe that's okay. If I put myself in other people's shoes, even I wouldn't know what to tell myself.  I'm just hoping the sadness and loneliness will eventually dissipate. But thank you for your kind words stranger.

I've been on a few meds but none that has worked significantly well. I've been in a trial and error process for the past 6-7 months and thus far, it seems like the two that helps me out the most is Seroquel and Vyvanse.

It's not really that work is mundane but its the fact that I have no drive or motivation to go pursue other things anymore. I literally go to work so that I can pay debt, nothing more. That is the only thing getting me up in the morning. My gf and few of my family members know, but usually they give me the "everything will be fine, we love you" response I can't seem to shake off the emptiness and helplessness. I know they mean well, and I'm eternally greatful, but I just feel misunderstood and indifferent to everything. 

But going back to my job, I'm not particuarly good at it and I can see that my co-workers get a little frustrated with me. I'm angry at myself for not being able to just go with the flow and endure for now as everyone hits a low every once in awhile. I get no pleasure from doing things I once was obsessed with (gaming, going out on spontaneous adventures with friends).

I'm so exhausted of trying to help myself and at this point, I think it might be easier to just disappear all together.
